`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_msb_256
        wire [15:0] group_valid;
        wire [15:0] group_enable;
        wire [15:0] group_winner;
        wire [15:0] low_column [3:0];
        genvar g, j, b;
        for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            wire [15:0] local_input;
            wire [15:0] local_winner;
            wire [3:0] local_encoded;
            assign local_input = input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
            assign group_valid[g] = |local_input;
            if (g == 15) begin : top_group
                assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
            end else begin : other_group
                assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
            end
            assign group_winner[g] = group_valid[g] & group_enable[g];
            for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : positions
                if (j == 15) begin : top_position
                    assign local_winner[j] = local_input[j];
                end else begin : other_position
                    assign local_winner[j] = local_input[j] & ~(|local_input[15:j+1]);
                end
                if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : default_position
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] = group_enable[g] & ~(|local_input[15:1]);
                end else begin : ordinary_position
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] = group_enable[g] & local_winner[j];
                end
            end
            assign local_encoded[0] = |(local_winner & 16'haaaa);
            assign local_encoded[1] = |(local_winner & 16'hcccc);
            assign local_encoded[2] = |(local_winner & 16'hf0f0);
            assign local_encoded[3] = |(local_winner & 16'hff00);
            for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : columns
                assign low_column[b][g] = local_encoded[b] & group_enable[g];
            end
        end
        for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : low_outputs
            assign output_encoded[b] = |low_column[b];
        end
        assign output_encoded[4] = |(group_winner & 16'haaaa);
        assign output_encoded[5] = |(group_winner & 16'hcccc);
        assign output_encoded[6] = |(group_winner & 16'hf0f0);
        assign output_encoded[7] = |(group_winner & 16'hff00);
        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    end else begin : original_general_case
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded;
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
        assign input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
        genvar l, n;
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end
        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ? {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} : {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ? {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} : {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end
        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline routes priority decisions through an eight-level encoded-selection tree and then decodes the encoded result into 256 outputs. Its reported critical path includes a heavily loaded select/buffer path followed by mux and decode logic.",
  "rewrite": "Specialize the fixed instance into sixteen 16-bit groups. Compute local highest-set-bit winners and higher-group suppression in parallel. Generate output_unencoded directly from these signals, bypassing encoded-to-one-hot decoding. Generate the encoded upper nibble from group winners and the lower nibble from group-enabled local encodings. Retain the original implementation for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to improve the 2.60 ns baseline by eliminating the serial priority-encode/decode path and reducing global encoded-bit fanout. No mapped timing result is available; the actual gain and maximum arrival require the specified synthesis and STA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Uses parallel local winner logic and group suppression instead of a global decoder. Local winners are shared between the encoded and unencoded outputs. Area is expected to remain competitive with the baseline, but compliance with the 8862.124480 um^2 cap and zero electrical violations has not been measured or certified.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For WIDTH=256 and LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0, every nonzero input selects its highest asserted bit. The all-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=256'b1, preserving the original unqualified shift behavior. Module interface, parameter defaults, parameter declarations, and output widths are retained. Other parameter configurations use the original logic, including its truncations and default behavior. The design is combinational and introduces no assumptions, storage, latency, or dependencies. Formal and mapped equivalence have not been run."
}
